rounds.text: Oswal Agro Mills Ltd is fundamentally mispriced relative to its asset backing, trading at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of 0.73x on a book value of ₹ 53.5 against a share price of ₹ 39.0 [E2]. This deep asset discount is further validated by independent key ratios showing an even more attractive price-to-book ratio of 0.58x, which compares very favorably against the sector benchmark of 1.46x [E7]. Beyond pure asset value, the business has demonstrated structural profit compounding over medium-term horizons, delivering a compounded profit growth of 18% over 5 years and 9% over 3 years [E19, E20], alongside a solid 10-year compounded profit growth of 10% [E18]. Operational efficiency is also competitive, with the company generating a return on assets (ROA) of 0.96%, closing in on the sector benchmark of 1.4% [E8]. This fundamental deterioration extends across multiple horizons, with compounded sales growth rates slowing to -12% over 3 years and -8% over 5 years [E15, E16].
